scope: cluster planner deterministic CPU fixtures, CLI and regression; no live GPU/network/token performance

implementation.procedure: read actual planner, CLI, integration and trust boundaries
implementation.acceptance: strict input contracts and advice-only boundary verified; primary research recommendations and main entry integration traced

reference_boundary.procedure: independent small placement cases and rejection edges
reference_boundary.acceptance: frozen_cases in plan_v2 pass including independently invented small cases; no GPU reuse, no partial gang, no dependency bypass; huge JSON integers in time/runtime/startup/link fields must reject cleanly with invalid JSON exit2, no traceback; valid JSON nested depth10000 under input size cap must return invalid/exit2 without traceback

data_integrity.procedure: check input/code/config/log hashes and failed runs
data_integrity.acceptance: all frozen code/input/log hashes match; failed intermediate logs retained; baseline SHA and dirty code explicit

numerical_sanity.procedure: finite seconds/bytes, resource conservation and no overlap
numerical_sanity.acceptance: no NaN/Inf, unit ambiguity, negative capacity or overlapping GPU placements; heuristic does not claim optimality

measurement_validity.procedure: no hardware performance or token claim; tests wall clock diagnostic only
measurement_validity.acceptance: independent checks pass within declared scope; retain all failures

reproducibility.procedure: rerun targeted suite and CLI frozen example
reproducibility.acceptance: independent targeted suite and example reproduce; full required regressions pass

execution.environment_description: local container CPU fixture, no GPU or remote hosts accessed
